English: Open Table
A rough table set in the open, where traders gather to barter wares and news, marking the first step in organized nomadic commerce.
Barter Patch
A staked-out patch of ground with rough mats and a few tables, where clans meet to exchange livestock, tools, and stories.
Traders Tent
A sturdy felt tent offering shelter to merchants and their goods, providing a more permanent hub for commerce and gathering.
Merchants Pavilion
A spacious, colorful tent complex bustling with traders, minor artisans, and suppliers—an early hub of nomadic market life.
Market Stand
A row of permanent wooden stands and awnings, providing protection for goods and a sense of stability to the growing camp marketplace.
Exchange Room
A sturdy semi-permanent timber structure where clan leaders and trusted merchants settle major deals, negotiate, and exchange rare goods.
Market Hall
A large, well-constructed hall of wood and canvas, filled with bustling stalls and spaces for trade, feasts, and major gatherings.
Zoroastrian Grand Market
A sacred, awe-inspiring market complex dedicated in the Zoroastrian tradition, blending trade, religious rituals, and clan unity into a singular spiritual and economic heart.
Guild Pavilion
A complex of tents and wooden structures housing merchant guilds, offering advanced services, security, and regulation for the nomadic market.
Grand Market Room
A vast, opulent wooden hall and tent complex, center of commerce, diplomacy, and celebration for the steppe clans.
